chapter: Will Marion Cook and the Southern Syncopated Orchestra
title: How 'Characteristic Blues' was arranged
summary: Cook wrote full chord arrangements behind Bechet's blues theme, and Bechet improvised within the harmonies.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well, that thing that he played, that 'Characteristic Blues,' was that
-- did they have an arrangement for that, or were there chords behind them or what?
Yes. On the piano, it's all arranged. Dad Cook arranged it. We had a piano and we had chord arrangements for the brass and everything.
I see. So it was a real full arrangement.
And then he would play solos.
Everything was arranged. The harmony was arranged by Dad Cook according to the theme, the blues theme played by Bechet, you see.
